planted.world: tabular mode (docs/11 section 6, default engine, not dense-equivalent): F binary features iid Bernoulli(0.5); labels iid from a Zipf(a) distribution p over V classes, independent of the features. Every context therefore has the same p(c), so A2 (representability) and A5 (known p) hold exactly; A1 holds for V <= v_slots = 64 and is broken on purpose at V = 256 (slot pressure); B = 16 against B = 1024 shows the effect of batch staleness (A4)
planted.measure: mean over 10 evenly spaced snapshots of the last epoch and over the 2,000 test rows of S_c/T (raw) and clamp(S_c, -T, T)/T, per class, against tanh(x_c/2) with x_c = ln(p_c / ((1 - p_c) Q / (V - 1))); per run: R^2 over the classes (unweighted, no fitted parameter), max |deviation|, Spearman(mean S, ln p) over the classes with p > 20 b
